status.en: 113 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 40% fewer than the week before, most of them in Islamabad, Balochistan and Kabul.
status.nb: 113 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 40 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Islamabad, Belutsjistan og Kabul.

summary.en: Taliban forces fired on Pakistani security troops along the Kurram border, killing a Pakistani officer and several militants, while Pakistan halted trade at two Iran border crossings and a dispute over the Zangali checkpost is disrupting operations at the Torkham crossing as it advances a defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey. The United Nations warns Afghanistan is one step away from famine and the Taliban opened a road to China that faces security hurdles. Iran halted LPG supplies, creating a shortage and price surge in Pakistan. 1,794 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Talibanstyrker skjøt på pakistanske sikkerhetstropp langs Kurram-grensen, og drepte en pakistansk offiser og flere militante, mens Pakistan stoppet handelen ved to grenseoverganger til Iran og en tvist om Zangali-sjekkposten forstyrrer operasjonene ved Torkham-overgangen ettersom landet fremmer en forsvarspakt med Saudi-Arabia og Tyrkia. FN advarer om at Afghanistan er ett skritt fra hungersnød og Taliban åpnet en vei til Kina som møter sikkerhetsutfordringer. Iran stoppet LPG-leveranser, noe som skapte knapphet og prisøkning i Pakistan. 1,794 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
